NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed two updates (+3 lines) and says the failing tests are fixed. The label came with no written feedback, so there's nothing else to check the push against.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️  | Tests: CI status isn't available, so "fixed the failing tests" can't be confirmed. |
| ❌  | "Fix click behavior on text and icons" fixes the first commit's own work, so it should be squashed into that commit. |
| ❌  | The self-review checklist leaves end-to-end button behavior and corner cases unchecked, even though a click bug was just found and fixed. |
| ℹ️  | The issue is "help wanted" and assigned to the author, so claiming it is fine. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask for the squash and a completed checklist. Re-check once CI is green.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Please squash the "Fix click behavior" commit into the first commit, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html). Also finish testing and ticking the remaining self-review items, such as button interactions and corner cases, and confirm CI is passing.
```
